items.name: Smoked Beef Samosas
items.description: Crisp pastry parcels filled with slow-smoked beef, onion and green chilli, served with a tamarind and mint chutney.
items.alt: Three golden samosas beside a small bowl of tamarind chutney

items.name: Sukuma and Coconut Fritters
items.description: Collard greens, grated coconut and turmeric fried into light fritters, with a lime and chilli dip.
items.alt: Green and gold fritters stacked on a plate with a lime wedge

items.name: Mukimo Croquettes
items.description: Mashed potato, peas, sweet corn and pumpkin leaves, crumbed and fried, with a fresh tomato and onion kachumbari.
items.alt: Golden round croquettes served with a bright tomato and onion salad

items.name: Peri-Peri Calamari
items.description: Lightly floured squid tossed in a coastal peri-peri and lemon dressing, served with garlic aioli.
items.alt: Crisp calamari rings dusted with chilli beside a lemon wedge

items.name: Butternut and Ginger Soup
items.description: Roasted butternut squash blended with ginger and coconut milk, finished with toasted pumpkin seeds.
items.alt: A bowl of orange butternut soup topped with pumpkin seeds

items.name: Coconut Grilled Tilapia
items.description: Whole tilapia grilled over charcoal and finished with a creamy coconut and lime sauce. Comes with kachumbari and coconut rice.
items.alt: A whole grilled tilapia in coconut sauce with rice and a fresh salad

items.name: Nyama Choma Platter
items.description: Charcoal-grilled goat ribs and beef rump, seasoned with salt and lemon, with ugali, kachumbari and a house pepper sauce.
items.alt: A wooden board of charred grilled meat with ugali and salad

items.name: Chicken Tikka Pilau
items.description: Yoghurt-marinated chicken tikka on fragrant pilau rice cooked with cumin, cardamom and cloves.
items.alt: Pieces of chicken tikka on a mound of spiced pilau rice

items.name: Coastal Prawn Curry
items.description: King prawns simmered in a coconut and tomato curry with curry leaf and tamarind, served with steamed rice.
items.alt: A bowl of orange coconut curry with large prawns and rice

items.name: Ndengu and Chapati Bowl
items.description: Slow-cooked green gram stew with garlic and coriander, served with two layered chapatis.
items.alt: A bowl of green gram stew beside folded chapati

items.name: Cauliflower Steak with Dhania Chimichurri
items.description: A thick roasted cauliflower steak with a coriander and lime chimichurri, on a bed of spiced lentils.
items.alt: A charred cauliflower slice topped with green herb sauce on lentils

items.name: Beef Short Rib with Ugali Fries
items.description: Beef short rib braised for hours in tea and tomato, served with crisp ugali fries and pickled red onion.
items.alt: A glazed beef short rib with golden ugali fries and pink pickled onion

items.name: Mandazi with Chocolate Dip
items.description: Warm cardamom-scented mandazi with a dark chocolate and coffee dipping sauce.
items.alt: Triangles of golden mandazi beside a small pot of chocolate sauce

items.name: Passion Fruit Cheesecake
items.description: A baked vanilla cheesecake topped with a bright passion fruit curd.
items.alt: A slice of cheesecake with a glossy passion fruit topping

items.name: Coconut Rice Pudding
items.description: Rice slow-cooked in coconut milk with cardamom and a little palm sugar, finished with toasted coconut.
items.alt: A small bowl of creamy rice pudding sprinkled with toasted coconut

items.name: Roasted Pineapple with Vanilla Ice Cream
items.description: Pineapple roasted with brown sugar and chilli, served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
items.alt: Caramelised pineapple wedges with a scoop of vanilla ice cream

items.name: Dawa, No Alcohol
items.description: Fresh lime, honey and ginger stirred over crushed ice.
items.alt: A tall glass of lime and honey drink over crushed ice with a wooden stirrer

items.name: Masala Chai
items.description: Black tea simmered with milk, ginger and warm spices.
items.alt: A steaming cup of spiced milk tea

items.name: Passion Fruit and Mint Cooler
items.description: Fresh passion fruit pulp shaken with mint, lime and sparkling water.
items.alt: A glass of passion fruit cooler with mint leaves and ice

items.name: Kenyan Pour-Over Coffee
items.description: Kenyan beans brewed to order. Bright, fruity and clean.
items.alt: Coffee being poured through a filter into a glass carafe

items.name: Tamarind Iced Tea
items.description: Black tea cooled with tamarind, a little brown sugar and lemon.
items.alt: A glass of dark iced tea with lemon slices

items.name: Fresh Sugarcane Juice
items.description: Pressed to order and served cold with a squeeze of lime.
items.alt: A glass of pale green sugarcane juice with a lime wedge
